_doc: The title screen (ui/start_screen.gd). reveal_limit_s: the most it waits for the first view to be drawn before lifting the curtain: never a curtain for ever. The map 0 draws its first view in a few seconds; the limit only guards a machine that cannot. styles: the regional styles a new city can take, a list that grows by data (session-rules.md section 10); each says how the interface shows speed, length and money, the state staying in SI. units: an exact definition each, metres and seconds of the unit (1 mile = 1609.344 m, 1 foot = 0.3048 m: the international yard and pound of 1959). sizes: the maps a new city can take, by id in catalog/maps.json; an id the table does not have yet is left out. seed_max: the largest seed the form takes.
